# All about canned coffee (Action Points Bonus)

![All about canned coffee (Promotion Points Bonus)](/uploads/44_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Canned coffee is fundamentally not new. You have always been able to find canned coffee in containers or simply loose in the world in Appalachia and the way it works has always been the same. What is new is that we can now make canned coffee in our CAMPs using the new coffee machine and can take out a canned coffee every 10 minutes.

## Coffee machine for canned coffee

![](/uploads/fallout76-slocum-joes-kaffeemaschine-dosenkaffee.jpg)

- Current price: 500 Atoms (01/24/2024)
 - If you missed an Atom Shop offer, you can get them as described here: Atom Shop Items: This is how you get skins and items that are not currently on offer
- One coffee machine can be built per CAMP or workshop
- The coffee machine cannot be built in an accommodation
- Is a Atom Shop item, so it cannot be placed in other people's camps and there is no blueprint.
- Located in the build menu under "Resources".
- Produces a can of coffee every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Max. 4 cans of coffee in the coffee machine (if there are 4 cans of coffee in the machine, production will stop until you pick up the canned coffee)

## Canned coffee effect

The effect of canned coffee is often misinterpreted and is not clearly described and recognizable in the game. In fact, canned coffee does not regenerate AP (action points), AP regeneration is not affected. Instead, **AP is generated for a short period of time**. This is a difference and has various advantages and disadvantages.

- 1 Canned Coffee generates **+12 AP per second** for a period of**25 seconds**
- Stacks arbitrarily
- Generates a total of 300 Action Points (AP) over 25 seconds
- Does not spoil (indefinite shelf life)

This means that if you drink 3x canned coffee, +36 AP per second will be generated, if you drink 10x canned coffee +120 AP per second, etc.

This generation of AP also works while you are consuming AP. Normal AP regeneration only works if you don't use up the AP. If you e.g. In VATS, if you shoot or sprint at several or large opponents or use the jetpack, you use up your AP and only when you stop shooting will the AP be regenerated again. This regeneration can be buffed, for example: you can calculate and optimize with our AP calculator.

The effect is available for 25 seconds even with heavy use of action points and e.g. Suitable for speed runs (with weapons that consume a lot of AP) or for bridging certain distances with the jetpack. Not as a permanent effect.

If you e.g. If you don't have armor with AP acceleration, or in certain situations you want to buff your AP over a period of time, canned coffee is not the right thing, but just a supplement for even more buff. For optimizing acceleration, e.g. is suitable: very good the mutation herbivores with visitor tea. This combination reduces the AP acceleration (0-100%) from a maximum of 16.6 seconds to 3.2 seconds. You can plan for other factors using the AP calculator.

## Canned coffee farms

Of course, in addition to using the coffee machine, it is still possible to farm the canned coffee yourself.

The best way to do this is as follows:

1. Equip the "Luck in Cans" perk under Luck in your skillset (It's best to set it to 3 to maximize the chance of getting more loot)
2. Travel to Whitespring / Watoga and other places where there are many containers (e.g. trash cans).
